<policies>
    <!--
        Relecloud Service Desk MCP gateway: API servicedesk-read (client path /servicedesk-read/mcp,
        backend <Container App>/read/mcp). Applied by setup/bicep/modules/apim.bicep, which loads
        this file as it is, so this file is the deliverable and the deployed policy at once.

        What it enforces, in order:
          1. Correlation: a well-formed incoming x-correlation-id (a GUID) is kept, anything else is
             replaced by the gateway request ID, so a caller can never inject text into the logs.
             The same value goes to the backend and back to the caller, also on errors.
          2. Identity: validate-azure-ad-token accepts only a signed-in user's token issued in this
             tenant to the gateway client app, for the gateway audience, carrying the delegated
             scope ServiceDesk.Access. Anything else gets 401.
          3. Who is asking: x-user-oid and x-user-name come from the validated token, and
             x-agent-id from the named value that provisioning sets to the agent's Entra Agent ID.
             Incoming copies of these headers are overwritten, never trusted.
          4. Backend trust: x-backend-key comes from the Key Vault named value mcp-backend-key.
             Authorization, Origin and any subscription key are removed before forwarding.
          5. Streaming safety: nothing here reads or rewrites the response body.
    -->
    <inbound>
        <base />
        <set-header name="Origin" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-variable name="correlationId" value="@{
            string incoming = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-correlation-id", "");
            Guid parsed;
            return Guid.TryParse(incoming, out parsed) ? parsed.ToString() : context.RequestId.ToString();
        }" />
        <validate-azure-ad-token tenant-id="{{tenant-id}}" header-name="Authorization" failed-validation-httpcode="401" failed-validation-error-message="Unauthorized. This gateway accepts only a signed-in Relecloud technician's token for the Service Desk scope." output-token-variable-name="userToken">
            <client-application-ids>
                <application-id>{{mcp-gateway-app-id}}</application-id>
            </client-application-ids>
            <audiences>
                <audience>{{mcp-gateway-app-id}}</audience>
                <audience>api://{{mcp-gateway-app-id}}</audience>
                <audience>{{mcp-gateway-audience}}</audience>
            </audiences>
            <required-claims>
                <claim name="scp" match="any" separator=" ">
                    <value>{{mcp-gateway-scope}}</value>
                </claim>
            </required-claims>
        </validate-azure-ad-token>
        <rate-limit-by-key calls="120" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@(((Jwt)context.Variables["userToken"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", "unknown"))" />
        <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-user-oid" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(((Jwt)context.Variables["userToken"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", ""))</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-user-name" exists-action="override">
            <value>@{
                var jwt = (Jwt)context.Variables["userToken"];
                return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("preferred_username", jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("upn", ""));
            }</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-client-app-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@{
                var jwt = (Jwt)context.Variables["userToken"];
                return jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("azp", jwt.Claims.GetValueOrDefault("appid", ""));
            }</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-agent-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>{{agent-id}}</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-gateway-api" exists-action="override">
            <value>servicedesk-read</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-gateway-caller" exists-action="override">
            <value>agent</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-backend-key" exists-action="override">
            <value>{{mcp-backend-key}}</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
        <trace source="servicedesk-gateway" severity="information">
            <message>@("servicedesk-read " + (string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</message>
            <metadata name="correlation-id" value="@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])" />
            <metadata name="user-oid" value="@(((Jwt)context.Variables["userToken"]).Claims.GetValueOrDefault("oid", ""))" />
        </trace>
    </inbound>
    <backend>
        <base />
    </backend>
    <outbound>
        <base />
        <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</value>
        </set-header>
    </outbound>
    <on-error>
        <base />
        <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("correlationId") ? (string)context.Variables["correlationId"] : context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
        </set-header>
    </on-error>
</policies>

<policies>
    <!--
        Relecloud Service Desk MCP gateway: API servicedesk-diag (client path /servicedesk-diag/mcp,
        backend <Container App>/mcp, every tool). Used from the lab VM for diagnostics (the lab
        tools and the readiness check) with the subscription key of the product
        servicedesk-diagnostics. Applied by setup/bicep/modules/apim.bicep, which loads this file
        as it is.

        This API carries no signed-in user: it removes every user and agent header a caller might
        send, so the MCP server runs read tools as its own application user (which never holds
        the contact phone column permissions) and refuses every write tool with
        USER_CONTEXT_REQUIRED. It keeps the same correlation rule as the agent APIs and adds the
        Key Vault backend key. Nothing here reads or rewrites the response body.
    -->
    <inbound>
        <base />
        <set-header name="Origin" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-variable name="correlationId" value="@{
            string incoming = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-correlation-id", "");
            Guid parsed;
            return Guid.TryParse(incoming, out parsed) ? parsed.ToString() : context.RequestId.ToString();
        }" />
        <rate-limit-by-key calls="60" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@(context.Subscription.Id)" />
        <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-user-oid" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-header name="x-user-name" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-header name="x-client-app-id" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-header name="x-agent-id" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-header name="x-gateway-api" exists-action="override">
            <value>servicedesk-diag</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-gateway-caller" exists-action="override">
            <value>operator</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="x-backend-key" exists-action="override">
            <value>{{mcp-backend-key}}</value>
        </set-header>
        <set-header name="Authorization" exists-action="delete" />
        <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
        <trace source="servicedesk-gateway" severity="information">
            <message>@("servicedesk-diag " + (string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</message>
            <metadata name="correlation-id" value="@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])" />
        </trace>
    </inbound>
    <backend>
        <base />
    </backend>
    <outbound>
        <base />
        <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@((string)context.Variables["correlationId"])</value>
        </set-header>
    </outbound>
    <on-error>
        <base />
        <set-header name="x-correlation-id" exists-action="override">
            <value>@(context.Variables.ContainsKey("correlationId") ? (string)context.Variables["correlationId"] : context.RequestId.ToString())</value>
        </set-header>
    </on-error>
</policies>
